record.question: In a circle, the radius is 7cm and the perpendicular distance from the centre of the circle to its chord is 6cm. The length of the chord is:
record.explanation: The perpendicular from the centre bisects the chord, so its length is 2√(7² − 6²) = 2√13 cm. However, the printed PDF page 3 lists the fourth option as “2 cm”, whereas the supplied packet lists “2√13 cm”; none of the printed options is correct. Held pending resolution of this source/option discrepancy.
